sims.title: Ten frames: count to 20
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Tap + to add a counter and − to take one away. When the first frame is full, it makes a ten.

sims.title: Frog hops: adding and taking away
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Choose a starting number and how many hops. The frog hops forward to add, or back to take away.

sims.title: Day and night
sims.subject: Science and the World
sims.desc: The Earth spins round. The side facing the Sun has day. The other side has night.

sims.title: Living or non-living?
sims.subject: Science and the World
sims.desc: Look at each picture. Is it living or non-living? Tap the right button.

sims.title: Hundreds, tens and ones
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Add or take away blocks. Ten ones make a ten; ten tens make a hundred.

sims.title: Parts of a plant
sims.subject: Science and the World
sims.desc: Tap a part of the plant to find out its job. Press "Water the plant" to watch water travel up.

sims.title: Halves, thirds and quarters
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Choose how many equal parts, then tap the parts to colour them.

sims.title: Telling the time
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Move the slider to turn the clock in 5-minute steps. Then try the challenge.

sims.title: Ice, water and steam
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Make it colder or warmer and watch water change between solid, liquid and gas.

sims.title: Life cycles
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Pick a living thing and step through its life cycle.

sims.title: Shadows through the day
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Move the Sun across the sky from morning to evening. Watch the stick's shadow.

sims.title: Fraction wall
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Each row is one whole cut into equal parts. Tap two pieces to compare them.

sims.title: Food chain: grass, goats and wolves
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Watch how many of each living thing there are over time. Then remove the goats or the wolves and see what happens.

sims.title: The water cycle
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: The Sun heats the sea. Water evaporates, cools into clouds, and falls as rain. Make the Sun stronger and watch.

sims.title: Friction: a fair test
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Push a book with the same force across three surfaces. Only the surface changes — that makes it a fair test.

sims.title: Measuring angles
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Open the angle and read it on the protractor. Watch its name change.

sims.title: Pollination and seeds
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Send the bee to collect pollen from one flower and carry it to another. Then watch a seed form.

sims.title: Percentages on a hundred square
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Percent means "out of 100". Colour squares and see the fraction, decimal and percentage.

sims.title: Conductors and insulators
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Put each object into the gap in the circuit. Does the bulb light?

sims.title: Angles in a triangle
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Change the shape of the triangle. The three angles always add up to the same total.

sims.title: Balance-scale equation solver
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: An equation is a balance. Each box is x; each small block is 1. Do the same to both sides to keep it level until one x is left.

sims.title: Particles in three states
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Heat or cool water and watch its particles. Each dot is a particle.

sims.title: How tectonic plates move
sims.subject: Geography
sims.desc: Plates of the Earth's crust float on the hot mantle. Choose a kind of boundary and move time forward.

sims.title: Stacking cubes: volume of a cuboid
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Each small cube is 1 cm³. Change the length, width and height and count the cubes.

sims.title: Circuit builder: series and parallel
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: Close the switch, change the number of cells, and take a bulb out. Compare a series circuit with a parallel circuit.

sims.title: Planets orbiting the Sun
sims.subject: General Science
sims.desc: The eight planets orbit the Sun. Tap a planet to learn about it. Sizes and distances are not to scale.

sims.title: Zooming in on the number line
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Type a fraction like 3/4 or −5/2. Watch where it sits, then zoom in between two numbers.

sims.title: Moving car with a live distance–time graph
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: Set a speed, start the car, and stop it on the way. The graph is drawn as the car moves.

sims.title: Balloon rocket: action and reaction
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: A balloon is taped to a straw on a string. Let the air out and watch it move.

sims.title: Building atoms: electron shells
sims.subject: Chemistry
sims.desc: Choose an element from 1 to 20. Protons and neutrons sit in the nucleus; electrons fill shells of 2, 8, 8, …

sims.title: Photosynthesis in a leaf
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Carbon dioxide and water go in; glucose and oxygen are made using light. Change the light and the carbon dioxide.

sims.title: Line plotter: y = ax + b
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Choose a and b. The table of values is worked out and each point is plotted on the Cartesian plane.

sims.title: Waves: amplitude, frequency and sound
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: Change the amplitude and frequency of the wave. Press "Hear it" to listen to a sound of that pitch.

sims.title: Breathing model: lungs and diaphragm
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Watch the diaphragm and ribs. Change the breathing rate as if you were resting or running.

sims.title: Unrolling a circle: where π comes from
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Roll the circle along the line for one full turn. The track it leaves is its circumference.

sims.title: Folding a net into a solid
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: A net is a flat shape that folds into a solid. Slide to fold it and see which faces meet.

sims.title: Tides: the Moon pulls the oceans
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: The Moon's gravity pulls the ocean into two bulges. As the Earth spins, a coast passes through high and low tide.

sims.title: Seasons: the tilted Earth
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: The Earth's axis is tilted about 23.5°. Move through the year and watch which half leans towards the Sun.

sims.title: White blood cells at work
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Germs have got into the blood. Watch white blood cells hunt them. Try again after a vaccine.

sims.title: Ray box: reflection and refraction
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: Change the angle of the light ray. Use a mirror to see reflection, or a glass block to see refraction.

sims.title: A prism splits white light
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: White light enters a glass prism and comes out as a spectrum. Try a coloured filter.

sims.title: Zooming in: from cell to DNA
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Slide to zoom from a whole cell to the nucleus, a chromosome and finally the DNA double helix.

sims.title: Cell division: mitosis and meiosis
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Step through each stage. This model cell has 4 chromosomes (2 pairs); a human cell has 46.

sims.title: Gradient and intercept: y = mx + c
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Move the sliders for m and c and watch the line. The triangle shows rise over run.

sims.title: Pythagoras: squares on the sides
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: Change the two shorter sides of the right-angled triangle. Compare the areas of the squares.

sims.title: Current, voltage and resistance
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: Change the voltage and the resistance. The ammeter (in series) and voltmeter (in parallel) show what happens. Choose a fuse.
sims.marker: circuit with meters in the Virtual Lab

sims.title: Ionic and covalent bonds
sims.subject: Chemistry
sims.desc: Only the outer shells are drawn. Watch sodium give an electron to chlorine, or watch hydrogen and oxygen share.

sims.title: Reflex arc and reaction time
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Touch the hot pan to send a nerve impulse round the reflex arc. Then test your own reaction time with the falling ruler.

sims.title: How many cones fill a cylinder?
sims.subject: Mathematics
sims.desc: The cone and the cylinder have the same radius and height. Pour cones of water into the cylinder.

sims.title: Density column: float or sink?
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: Set the mass and volume of a block, then drop it into a jar of honey, water and oil.

sims.title: The life cycle of a star
sims.subject: Physics
sims.desc: Choose a star like our Sun or a massive star, then step through its life.

sims.title: The carbon cycle
sims.subject: Biology
sims.desc: Carbon moves between the air, living things, the ground and the ocean. Change how much fuel is burned and how much forest is left.
